items.title: Report: Kyle Monangai to have MRI on knee, Bears believe he avoided serious injury
items.summary: Running back Kyle Monangai made an early exit from Bears practice on Sunday after hurting his knee, but the team's current belief is that he avoided a major injury.
items.whyItMatters: It adds variety to the sports mix without turning the page into a full sports wire.

items.title: Dramatic last laps as GB take silver in men's and women's 4x400m relays
items.summary: Great Britain take silver in both the men's and women's 4x400m relay, with the last lap of each race going right down to the wire.
items.whyItMatters: Running and athletics widen the page beyond match coverage into performance and training stories.

items.title: What has been the impact of new owners on The Hundred?
items.summary: BBC Sport looks at the impact new owners have had on The Hundred as the first season since private stakes were sold in teams ends.
